name: pyautogui_snapshot_window
description:
Capture a specific app window annotated with numbered labels for each interactive sub-element (buttons, inputs, etc.).

Returns the annotated window screenshot and a list of elements with `abs_x`/`abs_y` absolute screen coordinates ready for clicking.

Get the `window_id` from `pyautogui_snapshot` or via `xdotool search --name <title>` in the bash tool.

window_id.description: X11 window ID of the app to inspect
